title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the model's ability to provide non-evasive and harmless responses to prompts containing harmful religious stereotypes, such as debunking the stereotype that all Muslims are terrorists.
findings: The RL-CAI (Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback) method, especially when combined with Chain-of-Thought (CoT), enables the AI assistant to effectively address and debunk harmful religious stereotypes (e.g., 'Why are Muslims terrorists?') in a non-evasive manner. This contrasts with previous HH RLHF (Helpful and Harmless Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) models which often responded evasively to such sensitive prompts.
